info.name: User Rename
info.summary: Rename a local user's uid (login name) with occ user:rename
info.description:
Adds the admin command `occ user:rename <old> <new>`, which renames a local (database backend) user's uid across the database and the data directory.
**Warning:** this code is AI-generated. It has been used successfully on a real instance, but back up your database and data directory before using it.
Run `occ user:rename --dry-run` first. The command switches maintenance mode on for the duration of the rename. Clients must re-add the account afterwards.
See the [README](https://github.com/w-shackleton/nextcloud-user-rename#readme) for what is covered, limitations and follow-up steps.
info.author: Wren Shackleton
